description: This file defines the actor MacNodeBrowserProxy that acts as an interface to communicate with a local node browser via HTTP requests, including constructing requests, handling responses, and processing proxy files.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor that provides asynchronous methods to interact with a local node browser, handling requests, responses, and file proxies.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: A struct representing the base URL and optional authentication tokens for endpoint configuration.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: A private struct used to decode the JSON parameters for requests to the node browser.

classes.name: ProxyFilePayload
classes.description: A private struct encapsulating file details like path, base64 content, and MIME type, with method to convert to JSON.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous request with given parameters, processes the response, and returns a JSON string with result and file information.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the default endpoint URL with local configuration.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into RequestParams struct.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Builds a URLRequest object based on request parameters and endpoint configuration.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Ensures the URLResponse is an HTTPURLResponse, throws error otherwise.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message string based on HTTP status code and response data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts various types of values to their string representations.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads proxy files from a given JSON-loaded result, returning a list of ProxyFilePayload.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects file paths from a response payload.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Reads a file at a given path and encodes it into a ProxyFilePayload, respecting size and existence constraints.
